title: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's…
description: A concurrency vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module (assign_headers function) allows improper synchronization of shared resources, potentially leading to remote code execution (RCE). This affects Apache HTTP Server versions from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 and mod_h2 releases from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
